note: 13D/A du 2022-06-09 : vente par SB Northstar LP à Cantor Fitzgerald Securities de 3 427 000 unités de Learn CW à 9,50 $ ; vente secondaire : aucune arête
quote: On June 8, 2022, SB Fund entered into a private purchase agreement (the "Private Purchase Agreement") with Cantor Fitzgerald Securities pursuant to which SB Fund agreed to sell to Cantor Fitzgerald Securities an aggregate of 3,427,000 Units, each Unit consisting of one Share and one half of one redeemable warrant, at a price of $9.50 per Unit, for an aggregate purchase price of $32,556,500.
